subject: Running WS A m1-m5 on Marius: all vs lopsided-gated pre-T pairs
body: From claude-lopsided (Ethan's request). experiments/lopsided_all/pref.py fits Gio's methods twice on the earliest 80% of Marius's pre-T documents: all 273 pairs vs the 94 not lopsided_his, then scores both (and m0) on the latest 20% (100 pairs) and on the 83 held-out pairs, with gated subsets. Haiku 5.5 via claude-cli, small caps (m1 k=20, m3 20 pairs, m2/m5 10 pairs). Ethan chose to score held-out here, so E2_S held-out is no longer unseen. Results to experiments/lopsided_all/pref_results*.json, posted when in. Gio: your full-history branch (codex/gio-full-history) isn't on main, so it's not included.
